outputs.explanation: The panel shows a single deconvoluted native MS spectrum for PacL1 with cadmium. The caption does not state whether this spectrum is representative of multiple independent measurements/experiments or a one-off acquisition, nor does it give any n-number or replicate type.
The panel shows a single deconvoluted native MS spectrum for PacL1Δ5 with cadmium. As with panel A, no information is given on whether/how many times this measurement was repeated.

Bar chart of the proportion of PacL1/PacL1Δ5/PacL2 bound to 0-3 Cd atoms, derived from native MS. No error bars are shown and the caption does not state how many independent measurements/preparations underlie each bar or what type of replicate (biological/technical) was used.
Bar chart of proportion bound to Zn atoms by native MS, same issue as panel C: no replicate number or type is stated in the caption.
Bar chart of proportion bound to Cu atoms by native MS; no replicate information (n or type) is provided in the caption.
Bar chart of proportion bound to Mn atoms by native MS; no replicate information (n or type) is provided in the caption.

Per-residue chemical shift perturbation (CSP) values for PacL1 upon zinc titration. Each residue/equivalent bar appears to represent a single measured chemical shift value from one NMR titration series; the caption gives no indication of how many independent titrations/samples were performed, nor a replicate type.
Per-residue CSP values for PacL1 upon cadmium titration, same as panel G: no replicate number or type is reported in the caption.
